title:
Comment of Renee Estelle in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152120.txt
documents.text:
Renee Estelle, Soldotna, AK.
I am opposed to allowing this data center to be built.  I rely on subsistence salmon from Cook Inlet, and do not support anything that might jeopardize our fishery.  There are also too many down sides to letting this project happen without a way to guarantee it won't harm wildlife, increase pollution and water temperatures, drain resources, and cost taxpayers and residents.  We don't need data centers.  Preserve our natural resources!
